scientific_integrity: Three representative integer-matrix computations and a complete labeled-orbit partition are reproducible from the embedded standalone verifier and its exact matrices. The homology comparison does not imply a homotopy classification, and no independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Integral homology does not classify the homotopy types of these complexes.
The seven-vertex Paley representative was previously calculated; only two other representative calculations and the three-class census are newly claimed.
title: Integral multipath homology classifies the three regular seven-vertex tournaments
